results.summary: Goal criteria 2, 3, 4 and 6 hold on the shipped files. Criterion 7 is unverified because validate.sh is banned by the write surface.
Phase 015 criterion 3 replay half is unexecutable inside this lineage and is recorded as unverified rather than passed.
The hub declares no agent or command binding and ships none: command is null on all three mode entries, stated as the contract in the schema description.
Both runtime mirrors are byte-identical to canonical at 312 files each; diff -rq returns no output for either skill and the mirror versions read 1.1.3.0.
All seven Bladebro commands the feature catalog names resolve to documented commands, and the five-tool set is stated identically in the CLI reference and the CLI README.
The index and the hub-routing folder agree on all seven scenario ids including MT-H01 and MT-H04, and the Aside parity scenario is capability-honest about the page.on gap.

noveltyJustification: No new findings this iteration. Weighted new = 0 against 14 carried weighted (two P1 at 5 each, four P2 at 1 each), so the ratio is 0.0. The iteration was not idle: it executed six protocols, retired eight suspected findings, and re-confirmed the carried P2 R1-P2-001 as still active.
